column1: # Tab-separated. One row per short-read population sample (can be many more
# individuals than the 23 assembled genomes — this is population-level
# resequencing data). Lines starting with '#' are ignored.
# species must be one of the 3 focal species labels used in
# assembly_manifest.tsv, OR the literal keyword "Outgroup" for outgroup
# samples (e.g. chicken/Gallus gallus resequencing) used to polarize the
# D-statistics. At least one Outgroup sample is required.
# 'xxx' = sample mapped and genotyped but EXCLUDED from Dsuite (Dsuite ignores
# the label xxx): used for the two putative STGR x GRPC hybrids (F5434, F5622).
# LEPC: 19 New Mexico birds of Objective 1 (2019 + 2026, ~25x; F10 omitted as a
# first-degree relative of F21, as in Objective 1; allopatric
# Southern DPS). No high-depth LEPC from the LEPC-GRPC hybrid zone exist yet;
# adding them is the priority for the next sequencing round.
